table.VID_CLOUD_FETCHING: Fetching the file from Google Drive.
table.VID_CLOUD_NOT_SHARED: The link did not give the file. Share it as "anyone with the link", or connect the Google account, then send the link again.
table.VID_CLOUD_TOO_LARGE: That file is larger than the media store takes (1 GiB, or the space left).
table.VID_CLOUD_NO_LENGTH: Google Drive did not say the file's size, so it was not fetched. Upload it on the page opened on this computer.
table.VID_CLOUD_FAILED: The file could not be fetched from that link.
